reviews.text:
Weird math and shameful tactics. The math is really weird and I don’t quite understand how I’m saving or not saving money in the middle of the week. Also, the tone of the prompts/tips/whatever are quite full of shame! I am not trying to go fully sober, just trying to cut back a little, and having one drink on a Friday night (for me) does not mean “losing control.” It makes me not want to fill out the prompts or use the app, honestly. Some more neutral language would be better. 
The UI and the fact that it is free is nice.

reviews.text:
Ew. At first, I loved this app. It gave helpful information to assist in quitting drinking, puts you in a support group with other people that use the app and has a tracker for calories saved/$ saved/drinks had. 

An irritating aspect is that the tracker is not a “running total” of these items. I would like to see the tracked items saved to date instead of the tracker resetting back to zero each week. But I could live with that. Now when I post in the online group, none of the posts are saved! It’s quite frustrating when you’re asking for help/feedback from someone just to go back into the app and see the post didn’t even register in the system. I’m emailing this company to ask for my yearly subscription money back, don’t waste your time trying this one.

reviews.text: Great app. This app is very helpful in multiple ways to cut back or quit drinking. It’s been well worth the fee and my reduction in drinking more than makes up for the money spent. It has a great online community of supportive members who encourage each other, share triumphs, challenges, and tips. It also has a bunch of “lessons” based on cognitive behavioral therapy and other models that you can do and re-do at your own pace, and as many times as you need. It has great tracking tools to track drinks, alcohol free days, urges, downsides, and benefits. Finally, it has great tech-support. There’s a contact form if you have any questions or problems with technical glitches, and they have been very responsive and helpful. Whether you want to quit or just cut back on your drinking for whatever reason I highly recommend it.

reviews.text:
Good app overall. I’ve been using the app for going on 2 weeks and have liked it enough to spring for the 6 month membership. I love the program and how there is so many helpful resources there. It really helped me the first couple of days staying distracted and reminding me why I got the app in the first place. The group feature is nice and serves it’s purpose as well. The tracker is ok but it could use some tweaks as many have said. I got this app a few days into being sober and wish I could add those dates to my tracker but there doesn’t seem to be an option. 

My only other critique, like many others, is the inability to private message people. I don’t understand the point of having “matches” and when you click “send a message” it sends you back to the group to mention them. There are certain people I connect with more than others and I don’t want to derail the group conversation by having sidebar conversations with individuals. I saw feedback from developers over a year ago that said this feature was “on the roadmap” but I’m disappointed to see it hasn’t happened yet. I’m keeping my fingers crossed that within my 6 month membership this becomes a reality, because otherwise I will likely cancel my subscription. Obviously like many said, some sort of block feature would be important, or even a setting in your profile where you could opt out of receiving private messages.

However, I think it is lacking in some features. I’m not the first to say there should be a calendar. I can’t see which days are being accurately tracked or even go back to see the dates I last drank. The tracking itself is sometimes inaccurate and it’s a fight to update it. I also don’t understand why you have “matches” with others within the group chat if you cannot DM those people. What is the point?

It would be nice also if there were a chat search feature. I would like to be able to search another persons older posts so I can understand their backstory or if people already exchanges where they are from.

Since most of this app it automated it shouldn’t be so much to ask for these updates.

reviews.text:
Good app! Helping me moderate my drinking. I’ve been using this app for a few weeks and for the most part I really like it. It has helped me immensely. I especially love the group I’ve been assigned to. Everyone is very encouraging and it’s interesting to hear others’ stories, and gather ideas and tips. 

I have some suggestions that I feel would make this app five star+:

Add a calendar so that we have a visual of our drinking, sobriety or urges. Use symbols. Perhaps one color for a drink, another for a dry day and another color for urges. 

**I’ve also had an issue with insights and reminders. I have found insights to be incorrect on several occasions. Plus, I’ve received several notifications that I have x number of drinks left towards my goal, and usually they’re off by at least one. This is frustrating when one is relying on this information for encouragement to quit or moderate drinking. 

The other issue is that when entering a drink or an urge, I cannot go back and correct mistakes.. even while I’m still in that particular function of the app. And I can’t go back and edit an entry.

So if these things were to be implemented or corrected, I will happily change my rating to 5 stars. :)

Thank you for this app. It is wonderful but will be GREAT with these improvements!

For recording and receiving accurate and easy to interpret data, try something else. Disappointing and demotivating app.
